hook: Whyte became CEO of the American Medical Association in 2025 after nearly seven years as Chief Medical Officer of WebMD, and earlier spent nearly five years at the FDA and over eight years as chief medical expert at Discovery Channel. He holds an MD and an MPH from Harvard.
name: John Whyte

timeline.event: Division Director, Coverage Group, Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
timeline.impact: Leads a division over five years at CMS

timeline.event: Director, Council Private Sector Initiatives, Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
timeline.impact: Directs private-sector initiatives for two years

timeline.event: Chief Medical Expert and VP, Discovery Channel
timeline.impact: Serves over eight years as chief medical expert

timeline.event: Director, Professional Affairs and Stakeholder Engagement, FDA
timeline.impact: Leads stakeholder engagement at the FDA for nearly five years
Serves nearly seven years as chief medical officer

timeline.event: Board Member, Alliance for Aging Research
timeline.impact: Serves on the board for over six years

timeline.event: Chief Executive Officer, American Medical Association
timeline.impact: Becomes CEO of the AMA, based in Chicago and Washington DC
Chairs the board of the AMA's health innovation company

quick_facts: CEO of the American Medical Association since June 2025
MD, Hahnemann University School of Medicine; MPH in Health Policy and Management, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
Served nearly seven years as Chief Medical Officer of WebMD before joining the AMA
Previously a director at both the FDA and the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality

achievements.title: CEO, American Medical Association, 2025-present
achievements.impact: Leads the largest professional association of physicians in the United States.

achievements.title: Chief Medical Officer, WebMD, 2018-2025
achievements.impact: Served nearly seven years as chief medical officer of a leading health information platform.

achievements.title: Director, Professional Affairs and Stakeholder Engagement, FDA, 2013-2018
achievements.impact: Led FDA stakeholder engagement for nearly five years.
